records.symptom: The generated agents/openai.yaml contained invalid UTF-8 text under the Windows locale.
records.root_cause: Generator input crossed a locale/encoding boundary.
records.containment: Regenerate metadata with ASCII-safe inputs, then apply a UTF-8 patch.
records.prevention_test: Read agents/openai.yaml as UTF-8 and reject replacement characters.

records.symptom: Skill Creator quick_validate.py could not start because PyYAML was absent.
records.root_cause: Validator runtime dependency is not installed in the bundled Python environment.
records.containment: Do not install an unapproved dependency; use targeted UTF-8/frontmatter/reference tests and record the validator limitation.
records.prevention_test: Run unittest contract checks; keep quick_validate dependency as an explicit environment gap.

records.symptom: A legacy Etsy Ads Help URL returned an internal error.
records.root_cause: The old article path no longer resolved through the public page fetch.
records.containment: Search the Etsy Help Center domain and open the current campaign and placement articles.
records.prevention_test: Treat URL fetch failure as a source failure; never infer the old content and require a current official replacement.

records.symptom: The baseline contract recorded the Etsy AI seller-tools article publication date as 2026-04-21.
records.root_cause: The date was not confirmed from the visible article header during the first training pass.
records.containment: The public article header was opened and showed June 29, 2026; update the source metadata and add page-operation evidence.
records.prevention_test: Publication dates require a visible official page field; otherwise leave them unknown.

records.symptom: No real Etsy shop_id, per-shop OAuth, Shop Manager session, Ads state or ERP binding is available.
records.root_cause: Owner authorization and real shop binding have not been configured.
records.containment: Remain in public read-only research, audit, draft and simulation modes.
records.prevention_test: ETSY_API_KEY and ETSY_OAUTH_TOKEN presence probes plus shop-scoped readback must pass before connected status.

records.symptom: The official Open API reference search index exposed taxonomy and inventory operation text, but the opened dynamic reference rendered only a Loading shell and page-level finds returned no matches.
records.root_cause: The public API reference is client-rendered and its operation body was not available in the opened text representation.
records.containment: Use the official repository's direct OpenAPI Specification JSON link. The downloaded official document now supports schema-level decisions, while live shop responses remain blocked.
records.prevention_test: A schema-dependent rule requires a renderable official page, downloaded official OpenAPI specification, legal sandbox response or authorized API response; indexed snippets alone cannot establish live support.

records.symptom: The packaged T One window displayed Python backend exited early with exit=9009.
records.root_cause: The configured Python backend exceeded the fixed 18-second health wait and was terminated; fallback py was missing and fallback python resolved to the Windows app alias.
records.containment: Use the configured bundled Python for read-only acceptance and submit a shared-core patch proposal for adaptive startup health waiting, executable validation and candidate-specific errors.
records.prevention_test: Cold-start the formal package under load and require backend health without killing a still-starting configured interpreter; invalid fallbacks must be skipped with an understandable error.

records.symptom: The Extensions page offered the Etsy capability-pack Install action while an Amazon US task was selected and displayed zero dependencies despite an independent Etsy authorization requirement.
records.root_cause: The existing install method validates task_id and pack_id but does not validate capability route compatibility or required connector state across platform, site, mode, ownership, store binding and execution identity.
records.containment: Do not click Install; keep the Amazon task unchanged and submit a minimal shared-core route-validation patch proposal.
records.prevention_test: ETSY-EVAL-053 must block platform-etsy installation into every non-Etsy task and show the missing Etsy store binding/OAuth instead of zero dependencies.

records.symptom: The combined test run reported contract latest-run reference drift after the connector evidence file had been added.
records.root_cause: The contract pointed to the connector run while the evidence index and training cursor still pointed to the prior native-AI run.
records.containment: Advance the existing evidence index and cursor atomically to the connector run; do not create another training state.
records.prevention_test: The validator must assert that contract asset reference, evidence-index latest path and training cursor all resolve to the same run id.

records.symptom: The directly opened official API Reference again rendered only a Loading shell.
records.root_cause: The reference body remains client-rendered in the available public page representation.
records.containment: Use the directly renderable official Listings Tutorial for seller-taxonomy and property rules; keep real schema response blocked until authorized API evidence exists.
records.prevention_test: Search-index text alone cannot mark live schema verified; taxonomy rules require a renderable official tutorial or authorized response.

records.symptom: The generic Listing minimum input contract still required design_id, designer_id and designer-rights evidence for every item class.
records.root_cause: A POD/design-oriented input template had leaked into the platform-common contract despite category-conditional workflows.
records.containment: Replace global design fields with tenant/project/product identity, taxonomy-or-unknown and category-conditional design, material, variation, digital-file, production and shipping inputs.
records.prevention_test: Anonymous digital, vintage, jewelry and home-goods evals must pass without inventing designer or apparel fields.

records.symptom: Public video searches returned irrelevant results and no official Etsy video with a legally accessible, topic-matched transcript for this increment.
records.root_cause: Search indexing did not surface a verifiable official Etsy transcript for title suggestions or personalization.
records.containment: Do not download, transcribe around platform controls, or distill video claims; rotate to the official Etsy OpenAPI specification, release notes and announcement.
records.prevention_test: Video evidence requires a canonical public URL, publisher identity and platform-permitted transcript; otherwise record blocked/no_increment for that source class.

records.symptom: The first combined run failed because one test still expected the previous taxonomy/digital learning-run ID after the cursor advanced.
records.root_cause: A literal latest-run assertion was not advanced atomically with the contract, evidence index and training-state cursor.
records.containment: Update the existing assertion to the OpenAPI title/personalization run and rerun the same combined suite.
records.prevention_test: Prefer resolving the latest-run path from the evidence index; when a literal cursor guard is retained, update it in the same patch as all three canonical cursor references.

records.symptom: Direct shell HTML fetches of four publicly rendered Etsy Help articles returned 403.
records.root_cause: The Help Center HTML delivery path rejected the non-browser shell request even though the public reader rendered the pages.
records.containment: Use the official public Help Center article API only for article metadata and content hashes, and the normally rendered Help pages for visible claims; do not bypass CAPTCHA, authentication or access controls.
records.prevention_test: A Help fingerprint may use Etsy's public article API when its canonical article ID/title matches the rendered page; private endpoints, anti-bot workarounds and missing page evidence remain prohibited.

records.symptom: The payment/financial-resources video linked by Etsy Help could not be fetched and no public transcript was available in the reader.
records.root_cause: The youtu.be redirect/video page was unavailable to the public fetch surface.
records.containment: Keep the video evidence unknown; do not download, transcribe around platform controls or infer claims. Use the linked official Help article text only.
records.prevention_test: A video can contribute facts only when publisher identity and a platform-permitted public transcript are both captured.

records.symptom: The canonical training cursor and contract referenced the seventh learning run, but the Etsy training Skill still linked the sixth taxonomy/digital run as latest.
records.root_cause: The previous cursor update test covered contract/index/state alignment but not the human-facing Skill latest-run link.
records.containment: Update the existing Skill link to the payment/settlement run and extend regression validation to require all four latest-run references to match.
records.prevention_test: Validator must compare contract asset ref, evidence-index latest path, training-state run ID and the Skill Markdown latest-run filename.

records.symptom: The first round-nine combined run rejected all four new official sources because the test required every verified_at value to equal the previous day's literal date.
records.root_cause: A baseline-snapshot assertion had been written as a permanent equality, so the continuous training loop could not accept later verification dates.
records.containment: Parse verified_at as an ISO date and require it to be no earlier than the canonical contract baseline, while retaining host, publisher, scope, applicability and claim checks.
records.prevention_test: A future incremental source with a later valid verification date must pass; a malformed or pre-baseline date must fail.

records.symptom: Direct shell HTML fetches of the current Cases Policy and Seller Purchase Protection legal pages returned 403 even though both pages rendered in the public reader.
records.root_cause: The Etsy legal HTML delivery path rejected the non-browser shell request, so a raw-body content hash was unavailable.
records.containment: Use the normally rendered pages for claims and store title, effective date, last-updated date and canonical URL as version fingerprints; keep content_hash null with an explicit blocked state and do not bypass access controls.
records.prevention_test: Legal-policy records without a raw hash must contain rendered-page evidence, canonical Etsy URL, effective date, last-updated fingerprint and blocked hash state; invented hashes or access-control workarounds must fail.

records.symptom: The official Seller Handbook advertising-performance article rendered publicly but returned 403 to a direct shell HTML fetch, so a raw-body content hash was unavailable.
records.root_cause: The Etsy Seller Handbook HTML delivery path rejected the non-browser shell request while the normal public reader remained available.
records.containment: Record the rendered title, author and publication-date fingerprints, do not bypass delivery controls, and do not promote its third-party benchmark examples to canonical rules; use the hashable official Help Center articles for distilled metric claims.
records.prevention_test: Seller Handbook evidence without a raw hash may remain run-level context only; canonical metric rules must cite a fingerprinted official source, and third-party benchmark values must never enter stable rules.

records.symptom: Initial PowerShell fingerprint commands used unavailable framework hashing methods, and direct foreach-to-pipeline forms produced parser errors during two read-only inventory attempts.
records.root_cause: The script assumed newer .NET APIs and used a PowerShell loop form that this host parser rejects.
records.containment: Use Invoke-WebRequest with SHA256.Create, accumulate loop output into an array before piping, and discard every failed output; no evidence claim was created from those attempts.
records.prevention_test: Fingerprint helpers must use host-compatible primitives, return a nonempty SHA-256 and status, and local inventory loops must accumulate before formatting; failed output cannot enter evidence.

records.symptom: Unauthenticated GitHub REST tree, contents and community requests reached the public rate limit after the organization and repository metadata screen.
records.root_cause: The audit used the public unauthenticated quota and the remaining calls exceeded it.
records.containment: Stop REST access without requesting a token, bypassing the limit or increasing retry pressure; retain already rendered GitHub HTML coverage and mark unavailable regions explicitly.
records.prevention_test: A rate-limit response must stop that source class for the run, create blocked coverage, prohibit invented issue/tree facts and permit only already visible public page evidence.

records.symptom: The owner-authorized current Chrome session could not initialize, and the required browser troubleshooting document was unavailable after the failed initialization.
records.root_cause: The browser extension runtime failed before exposing a controllable tab or recovery documentation; no browser content or account data was accessed.
records.containment: Stop Chrome work for the run without alternate profiles, cookie/session inspection or repeated connection attempts; retain public-page coverage and mark login-only or dynamically missing regions blocked.
records.prevention_test: A Chrome supplement may proceed only after the current extension session and complete browser documentation load successfully; on bootstrap failure it must record zero browser actions and no private data access.

records.symptom: The first combined run rejected the verified Etsy organization root because the validator accepted only /etsy/* repository paths, and one test still expected the prior latest learning-run link.
records.root_cause: The new official-organization evidence shape and atomic latest-run cursor change were not fully represented in two existing validation assumptions.
records.containment: Accept only the exact /etsy organization root or /etsy/* paths, update the latest-run assertion to the new run, and rerun the complete validator and unit suite.
records.prevention_test: Tests must accept the exact verified organization root while rejecting other GitHub owners, and the contract/index/state/Skill/test latest-run references must advance together.

records.symptom: The first round-14 validator required every contradiction source to be official-only, while the new Plus-loading contradiction correctly referenced a Reddit single case; two tests also retained the prior latest-run cursor.
records.root_cause: The contradiction validator and latest-run assertions had not yet been generalized for a versioned official-versus-community conflict.
records.containment: Allow contradiction evidence from the canonical official-or-practice source union, preserve the practice source as single_case, update only the latest-run assertions, and rerun the full suite.
records.prevention_test: A contradiction may cite canonical practice evidence without promoting it to an official rule, while contract, evidence index, training state, Skill and tests must share one latest-run cursor.

records.symptom: The first round-16 unit run passed the validator but one Skill-resource assertion still expected the Round 15 learning-run path.
records.root_cause: The contract, evidence index, training cursor and Skill had advanced atomically, but one test fixture retained the prior latest-run filename.
records.containment: Update only the stale expected filename to the Round 16 canonical run and rerun the full targeted plus shared platform suite.
records.prevention_test: Every learning-run advance must assert the same canonical filename across contract, evidence index, training state, Skill and tests before the combined run is considered successful.

records.symptom: Normal raw-response probes for two Seller Handbook Listing-video articles returned 403 after their rendered public pages were readable.
records.root_cause: Etsy's raw response path did not expose the article HTML to the normal probe, while the public rendered reader still provided the title, author, date and complete relevant sections.
records.containment: Stop raw probing without bypass or alternate identity, retain deep rendered-page coverage and explicit version fingerprints, and leave content_hash null with a blocked_raw_html state.
records.prevention_test: A readable Seller Handbook page may enter evidence with a null hash only when content_hash_state and at least three stable version fingerprints are present; no retry, anti-bot workaround or connection claim is allowed.

records.symptom: The first validator command resolved python to the WindowsApps placeholder and exited with code 1 without running the validator.
records.root_cause: The shell PATH exposed the Microsoft Store Python alias instead of a working interpreter for this workspace.
records.containment: Load the bundled workspace dependency paths, run the validator and unittest suite with the exact bundled Python executable, and retain the failed alias attempt as an execution trace rather than a test result.
records.prevention_test: On Windows, resolve a real Python executable before the first Etsy training validation; a placeholder alias failure must not be reported as a validator failure or hidden after a successful rerun.

records.symptom: The owner-authorized current Chrome connection again failed before any tab could be listed or claimed because the runtime could not initialize its process binding.
records.root_cause: The extension runtime failed during bootstrap; no Etsy, social, account or private page was opened through Chrome in this round.
records.containment: Stop Chrome work without inspecting cookies, tokens, passwords, profiles or alternate identities; continue only with public sources and record the missing logged-in supplement.
records.prevention_test: A Chrome evidence claim requires successful runtime documentation and a tab obtained from the live open-tab list; a pre-tab bootstrap failure must yield zero browser-page evidence.

records.symptom: The first local fingerprint command used a static SHA-256 method that is not available in the installed PowerShell/.NET runtime.
records.root_cause: The hashing implementation assumed a newer .NET API rather than the compatible SHA256.Create pattern.
records.containment: Treat this as a local tooling error, switch only the hashing implementation for later ordinary public responses, and do not relabel it as an Etsy page or connector failure.
records.prevention_test: The fingerprint probe must use a compatible hashing path and report HTTP retrieval separately from local hash computation.

records.symptom: Normal public JSON probes for the craft-supply, resale and removal-reasons Help articles returned 403 after the rendered pages were deeply readable.
records.root_cause: The rendered Help surface remained public while the raw JSON path did not permit the ordinary probe in this environment.
records.containment: Stop without retry, bypass, alternate identity or scraping workaround; retain the rendered deep-coverage evidence, a null hash and stable page-version fingerprints.
records.prevention_test: These Help sources may have a null content hash only with the blocked_raw_json state, at least three stable version fingerprints, full page coverage and no API-connection claim.

records.symptom: The first Round 18 validator found the contract latest-run path still on Round 17; the next run found a community source placed in a curriculum field that intentionally accepts official sources only.
records.root_cause: Two existing atomic-update assumptions were not advanced consistently when the new run and comment evidence were first added.
records.containment: Move the canonical latest-run reference to Round 18, keep the Reddit record in practice/evidence/contradiction rather than the official curriculum source list, and rerun the validator plus full Etsy/shared suite.
records.prevention_test: A round advance must atomically align contract, evidence index, training cursor and Skill; curriculum evidence_refs remain official-only while practice sources stay in the practice/evidence channels.

records.symptom: The first multi-URL PowerShell fingerprint command failed to parse because a foreach block was piped without collecting its output.
records.root_cause: The diagnostic command used an invalid PowerShell pipeline shape; no Etsy response or local asset was changed.
records.containment: Collect each read-only result in a task-specific array, run the corrected command once, and keep the parser failure separate from Etsy availability.
records.prevention_test: Multi-target fingerprint probes must parse locally before network interpretation and must report shell failure separately from per-URL HTTP status.

records.symptom: One ordinary raw HTML request for the fully rendered Keywords 101 Seller Handbook page returned 403.
records.root_cause: The rendered public page was readable through the public web surface while the normal raw request was not permitted in this environment.
records.containment: Stop after the single normal request without retry, alternate identity, header spoofing or bypass; retain a null hash plus stable rendered-page version fingerprints.
records.prevention_test: The Keywords 101 record may have a null hash only with blocked_raw_html_403_rendered_page_verified, at least three stable fingerprints, at least 90% rendered coverage and no live-shop claim.

records.symptom: The Attributes Help page's rendered 'attributes in search' secondary link resolved to a 404 path in the public reader.
records.root_cause: The rendered relative-link target omitted the expected locale path in this reader; this does not prove the same failure in an authenticated browser or Etsy product UI.
records.containment: Record the unavailable secondary page, rely only on the complete current Attributes Help and Keywords 101 pages, and do not retry with path guessing or claim a platform defect.
records.prevention_test: A failed secondary link must remain a reader-level blocked region unless the canonical current page is independently verified; it cannot create or change an Etsy rule by itself.

records.symptom: The first validator invocation resolved 'python' to the WindowsApps placeholder and exited without running the script or producing output.
records.root_cause: This desktop workspace exposes a Windows Store alias before the bundled Codex Python runtime.
records.containment: Resolve the configured workspace dependency path and rerun the same local validator with the bundled Python executable; do not treat the empty placeholder result as a pass or validator failure.
records.prevention_test: Etsy validation and tests must use the configured bundled Python executable and must require explicit exit code plus parsed output or unittest summary.

records.symptom: The skill-creator quick_validate.py entrypoint stopped before validation because the configured bundled Python does not include the yaml module.
records.root_cause: PyYAML is not present in the provided workspace runtime, and no other usable local Python installation was found.
records.containment: Do not install an unrequested dependency; run equivalent read-only checks for folder naming, frontmatter delimiters, allowed keys, required name/description, name/folder match, line count and agents metadata consistency, while retaining the official script result as unavailable.
records.prevention_test: Report quick_validate separately as dependency-blocked unless yaml is already available; never label a dependency import failure as a Skill validation failure or a pass.

records.symptom: The first full Etsy/shared suite produced 48 failures after the contract-level verified_at date was advanced and two older latest-run assertions were not updated.
records.root_cause: The global baseline date is a minimum for every source rather than the round timestamp, so advancing it invalidated unchanged 2026-07-18 sources; the generic review-state assertion also incorrectly required an empty opened-not-reviewed list.
records.containment: Restore the contract baseline date, keep per-source current verification dates, update the cursor expectation and assert opened-not-reviewed consistency rather than emptiness, then rerun the full suite.
records.prevention_test: Round advances must not change the global source baseline unless every source is reverified; latest-run tests must derive optional review-state inventories from the canonical run instead of assuming none exist.

records.symptom: The second full suite reduced failures to one stale literal for the previous learning-run path in the Skill reference test.
records.root_cause: The Skill and canonical cursor were advanced, but one test fixture still named the Round 18 ledger file.
records.containment: Advance the test fixture to the Round 19 ledger path and rerun the entire Etsy/shared suite.
records.prevention_test: A learning-run advance must update contract, index, state, Skill and every explicit test fixture in the same atomic patch or derive the expected path from the evidence index.

records.symptom: The unauthenticated GitHub REST recursive-tree request reached the public rate limit after bounded repository metadata collection.
records.root_cause: The public REST quota was exhausted while expanding repository trees without an authenticated GitHub token.
records.containment: Stop without token, login or bypass; continue the bounded audit with public HTML and selected raw files only.
records.prevention_test: Package discovery records API quota errors separately and never upgrades an unvisited tree, file or issue surface to fully reviewed.

records.symptom: Two PowerShell JSON parsing attempts failed with a parameterless-constructor error on the large official OpenAPI specification.
records.root_cause: The local PowerShell JSON path was incompatible with part of the large schema shape.
records.containment: Make no claim from failed parses and use the bundled Python read-only parser to enumerate the exact parameters.
records.prevention_test: A schema claim requires a successful full-document parser, exact document hash and explicit path/method/parameter output.

records.symptom: The first urllib fingerprint batch ended with IncompleteRead, and the bundled Python runtime did not include requests.
records.root_cause: A transient raw-file response was incomplete and the fallback dependency was not present.
records.containment: Do not install a dependency; use a bounded PowerShell pass to hash only selected, fully reviewed files.
records.prevention_test: Every package fingerprint must be tied to a selected file and successful byte count/hash result; transport failure creates no evidence claim.

records.symptom: The first validator run rejected a fully reviewed official discussion because it had only two visible comments although all visible comments and the sole nested reply were read.
records.root_cause: The prior validator encoded the normal sample-size threshold without the protocol's explicit 'or all' exception for a short complete comment set.
records.containment: Require the minimum sample or an explicit all_visible_comments_reviewed flag, while still requiring page-bottom and rendered-order evidence.
records.prevention_test: A short complete comment thread passes only when all-visible coverage, actual count, page bottom and unavailable regions are recorded; partial small samples still fail.

records.symptom: PDF screenshot calls returned no visible image output for the 20-page Amazon-specific SOP.
records.root_cause: The web PDF screenshot path did not return a usable visual artifact in the current tool session.
records.containment: Read every extracted-text page, mark visual verification unavailable, make no layout or image claim, and reject the dated Amazon/FBA/FBM package from Etsy adoption.
records.prevention_test: A PDF learning receipt distinguishes complete extracted-text coverage from visual verification and cannot claim visual QA without a rendered image.

records.symptom: The raw public fetch of the archived Reddit review guide returned HTTP 403 Blocked after the rendered page had been fully reviewed.
records.root_cause: Reddit denied the unauthenticated raw transport used only for byte fingerprinting.
records.containment: Stop without retry, alternate endpoint, login, token or bypass; save a hash of the explicit rendered structured receipt and label that basis instead of claiming a raw body hash.
records.prevention_test: A blocked raw fingerprint records transport, coverage basis and missing region; it cannot trigger a bypass or be mislabeled as the raw page body hash.

records.symptom: The first 63-test combined run had two stale latest-run assertions; an intermediate repair then pointed the topic-specific completeness assertion at the older Round 12 GitHub receipt whose page schema predated review_status.
records.root_cause: Topic-specific historical-run checks were coupled to the moving latest-learning-run pointer.
records.containment: Pin the GitHub/OpenAPI package-completeness test to the immutable Round 20 receipt that introduced those exact schema assertions, and make the Skill-resource test follow the Round 21 canonical latest path, without weakening any coverage or safety assertion.
records.prevention_test: Historical topic tests name their immutable run file; only cursor/Skill tests follow evidence-index latest_learning_run, and the full Etsy plus shared-platform suite is rerun after each cursor advance.
